memory_definitions.process_rss_max_gib_entire_vm: Maximum observed /proc PID stat RSS for benchmark JVM, 1 second samples over startup/warmup/measurement/drain; excludes Maven launcher. RSS includes Java heap and resident native memory. Not exact unique physical memory accounting for shared mappings.
memory_definitions.process_rss_max_gib_measured: Same RSS sampling restricted to formal traffic window; null for warmup failure.
memory_definitions.heap_used_max_gib_observed_at_gc_entire_: Maximum observed heap usage in GC logs; not continuously sampled peak, not retained live-set after full GC, not reserved/committed capacity.
memory_definitions.heap_capacity: 64 GiB committed heap by configuration, distinct from RSS and used heap; SoftMaxHeapSize=48g does not lower Xms64g.

limits: Same frozen source as prior matrix, excludes concurrent agent code changes. No production Java or JVM configuration changed.
Real Master/scheduler with synthetic loopback workers and synthetic terminal events. No GPU inference; NON_BATCH omits frontend fetch and actual delivery.
Harness retains payloads/responses/received batches, so allocation and live data include test machinery and grow with offered QPS.
3K cases and tuning cases are single runs unless additional repeats are recorded. Short ten second warmup and measurement; no claim of production capacity or long-term stability.
Two contemporaneous untuned 20K BATCH controls included. Previous and new controls retained separately, not cherry-picked.
No OS huge-page, THP, NUMA or host sysctl settings changed. ConcGCThreads128 leaves dynamic worker scaling enabled; 128 is an upper bound, not guaranteed active thread count.
Whole-VM allocation stalls and GC peaks include warmup/drain and are distinct from formal measurement metrics. CPU includes client/mocks/GC, not GC alone.
SoftMaxHeapSize and ConcGCThreads varied independently with and without PreTouch; no heap increase or SLO relaxation.
The JVM flag checks are startup initialization runs, not service readiness measurements.
runner_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export JAVA_HOME=/opt/flexlb-jdk21-20261002
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
export MAVEN_OPTS="-Xms512m -Xmx2g -Duser.home=/data0/luoli.hn/data0 -Dmaven.repo.local=/data0/luoli.hn/data0/.m2/repository"
unset JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS _JAVA_OPTIONS || true
source_root=/data0/luoli.hn/data0/work/rtp_llm_4/github-opensource/.tmp/flexlb-gc-factorial-20261009
root=/data0/luoli.hn/data0/work/rtp_llm_4/github-opensource/.tmp/flexlb-gc-tuning-20261009
mkdir -p "$root"
cd "$root"
cp "$source_root/revision.txt" "$source_root/archive.sha256" "$source_root/source-manifest.sha256" "$root/"
cd "$source_root"
sha256sum --quiet -c source-manifest.sha256
cd "$root"
mkdir -p evidence
{ cat revision.txt; java -version; uname -a; getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max 2>/dev/null || true; cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled; cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/shmem_enabled; free -h; } > evidence/environment.txt 2>&1
flags_for() {
 case "$1" in
  g1) flags='-XX:+UseG1GC -XX:-AlwaysPreTouch';;
  g1_pretouch) flags='-XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch';;
  zgc) flags='-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:-AlwaysPreTouch';;
  zgc_pretouch) flags='-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch';;
  zgc_soft48) flags='-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:-AlwaysPreTouch -XX:SoftMaxHeapSize=48g';;
  zgc_threads128) flags='-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:-AlwaysPreTouch -XX:ConcGCThreads=128';;
  zgc_pretouch_soft48) flags='-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:SoftMaxHeapSize=48g';;
  zgc_pretouch_threads128) flags='-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:ConcGCThreads=128';;
 esac
}
for profile in zgc_soft48 zgc_threads128 zgc_pretouch_soft48 zgc_pretouch_threads128; do
 flags_for "$profile"
 mkdir -p "evidence/startup/$profile"
 python3 "$root/startup.py" "evidence/startup/$profile/1" java -Xms64g -Xmx64g $flags -XX:+PrintFlagsFinal -version
done
cd "$source_root/rtp_llm/flexlb"
run_case() {
 profile="$1"; mode="$2"; qps="$3"; repeat="$4"
 flags_for "$profile"
 out="$root/evidence/$profile/$mode-$qps-r$repeat"
 mkdir -p "$out"
 printf '%s\n' "$flags" > "$out/flags.txt"
 decision=FIXED_WINDOW
 if [[ "$mode" == NON_BATCH ]]; then decision=SINGLE; fi
 python3 "$root/monitor.py" "$source_root" "$out/process.jsonl" "$out/monitor.stop" &
 monitor_pid=$!
 echo "START $profile $mode $qps repeat=$repeat $(date -Is)"
 code=0
 ./mvnw -B -P 'opensource,!internal,api-performance-regression' -pl flexlb-api -am \
  '-Dtest=MasterBatchEndToEndPerformanceTest#masterMeetsRateSloAcrossEngineScaleMatrix' \
  -DfailIfNoTests=false -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
  -Dflexlb.perf.heap=64g \
  "-Dflexlb.perf.jvm-args=$flags -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError -Xlog:gc*,safepoint:file=$out/gc-%p.log:time,uptime,level,tags" \
  "-Dflexlb.perf.delivery-mode=$mode" "-Dflexlb.perf.decision-mode=$decision" \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-topologies=750x750 \
  "-Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-target-qps=$qps" \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-duration-ms=10000 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-warmup-ms=10000 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-warmup-requests-per-prefill=16 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-min-qps-ratio=0.98 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-server-p99-ms=50 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-client-p99-ms=50 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-batch-wait-p99-ms=50 \
  test > "$out/test.log" 2>&1 || code=$?
 touch "$out/monitor.stop"
 wait "$monitor_pid"
 printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$out/test.exit"
 awk '/FlexLB Master engine-scale E2E:|FlexLB Master traffic failure:|\[ERROR\]   Master|OutOfMemoryError|BUILD SUCCESS|BUILD FAILURE/' "$out/test.log"
 echo "END $profile $mode $qps repeat=$repeat exit=$code $(date -Is)"
}
for mode in BATCH NON_BATCH; do
 for profile in g1 zgc_pretouch g1_pretouch zgc; do run_case "$profile" "$mode" 3000 1; done
done
for profile in zgc zgc_pretouch_soft48 zgc_threads128 zgc_pretouch zgc_soft48 zgc_pretouch_threads128; do
 run_case "$profile" BATCH 20000 1
done
cd "$source_root"
sha256sum --quiet -c source-manifest.sha256
printf 'done\n' > "$root/matrix.done"

assessment.soft48_pretouch_single_trial: 22.658ms vs contemporaneous untuned27.638ms; both pass, allocation stalls0, RSS68.74 vs68.71GiB. No demonstrated memory saving or stable latency improvement.
assessment.threads128: Both with and without PreTouch failed during warmup with executor rejection; observed128 young and128 old workers. Does not establish that GC contention caused rejection, and no formal latency is available.
assessment.soft48_without_pretouch: Warmup executor rejection; no formal P99, zero allocation stalls before failure is not proof of sufficient reclamation.
assessment.baseline_zgc: 110 warmup allocation stalls, maximum99.723ms, formal P99 38.094ms. Formal SLO pass does not remove warmup stalls.
assessment.recommendation: Keep original ZGC + PreTouch profile as the validated candidate for this synthetic benchmark. No production configuration change; extra tunings not established as preferable.
